concept: The Lab Window - A striking juxtaposition where a clinical, bright academic CAD canvas sits within a deep, dark technical dashboard. The 3D viewer acts as a precise engineering blueprint brought to life.

lighting.toneMapping: NoToneMapping or LinearToneMapping (Avoid ACES to keep flat academic look)
lighting.shadows: Soft contact shadows only, avoid harsh drop shadows to maintain technical drawing aesthetic.

selection_state.behavior: Click raycaster selects mesh, triggering both visual highlight and property panel entrance.

viewer_toolbar.position: Absolute bottom-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 or top-4 right-4

motion.hover_part: Cursor changes to pointer. Emissive intensity smoothly transitions to 0.05.
motion.select_part: Spring animation on the property panel scaling in from the clicked screen-space position to its fixed floating slot.
motion.panel_entrance: Framer Motion: initial={opacity: 0, y: 10}, animate={opacity: 1, y: 0}, transition={type: 'spring', stiffness: 400, damping: 25}.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure the light gray (#eef2f6) and edge outlines (#1e293b) exceed 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.keyboard: Ensure toolbar buttons and property panel inputs are fully keyboard navigable via Tab.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Disable smooth camera fly-to animations if user prefers reduced motion.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup the Three.js Canvas with a solid color background (cad_canvas.background). Do NOT use environment maps that add reflections.
2. Replace existing metallic materials with MeshStandardMaterial (roughness: 1, metalness: 0) mapped to the 'cad_materials_matte' hex codes.
3. Implement an EdgesGeometry overlay for EVERY mesh to give it that SolidWorks/technical drawing look.
4. Add a GridHelper (major) and a secondary GridHelper (minor) positioned exactly at the working plane (y=0 or base).
5. Add an AxesHelper fixed in the bottom-left corner of the viewport (use a separate small scene/camera or viewport scissor for this).
6. Build a Raycaster selection system. On click, highlight the selected mesh using emissive teal tint, and render the Floating Property Panel.
7. The Floating Property Panel must use the dark theme (#080b11) to tie back into the overall app aesthetic, providing a sharp contrast against the light canvas.
8. Use Shadcn components for the Property Panel inputs, deeply customized to remove default styles and match the dark, sharp-edged technical aesthetic.
9. Add Dimension lines (Cotas) using Three.js Line or CSS2DObject for the text overlays. Make them toggleable via the toolbar.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Focus on high-contrast juxtapositions. Do not use Inter for headings; stick to IBM Plex Sans/Mono. Do not use generic centered layouts. Create depth with z-index. Apply micro-animations on all interactive elements. Do not apply universal 'transition: all' to prevent transform breakage. Never use transparent backgrounds on floating UI elements. All interactive elements MUST have role-based kebab-case data-testids.
